notes.title: Update v2.0.0.0 - Brand new UI, user requested features and bugs fixes
notes.content:
The update v2.0.0.0 contains a big overhaul of the software, including a new user interface and many great features.

[url=http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/b2ca026e890b7feef9b4ce29332dd767eb6fd3b9.png][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/d4fa177ba4178679d2cd5073cf735be19548286e.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/19b9db79042ca4698048fe518b1338b4b39bc407.png][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/911520d0dc64836d82386a27e7f8b1343dd71154.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/42ca9a320b236be0b5bdace5ad2712d9fe40d36e.png][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/326630979458c11a8729ee689cad3a4304d9aee8.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/5307750fafd7ef36f93b2890fbc0e2328433954a.png][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/3cf7aa50bcc1e7961f2688ebaa78e827fc8f57b3.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/0ffd42dd8dffdee5c769e8d2d09084949935c8b2.png][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/bd9cdba0d29d784a01609ec50e332449219b5ee7.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/af3abb5a2e4bae5eb3fca8815631ee826b27662d.png][img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455292/2ad094ab82903845b4032630ed11d7d30589bb5f.png[/img][/url]

Change log
1. A new UI for wallpaper selection.
2. Dark theme for main user interface.
3. Selecting file path.
4. Built-in support for web page.
5. Built-in support for video files.
6. Autostart when computer starts.
7. Auto run the latest wallpaper when start.
8. Recent played file list for quick access.
9. Support most of the video formats.
10. Hot keys for quick setting wallpaper, hiding taskbar and desktop icons etc.
11. Option of keeping focus on wallpaper.
